body:
## Why
The backplane validator documents and implements an offline fixture suite under `tests/fixtures/backplane/`, but that directory is absent from the repository. `scripts/validate_run_contract.py:569-622` loads positive/negative JSON envelopes only when `tests/fixtures/backplane/` exists; on tip `5fb9a7d` it prints `NOTE: no fixtures found; schema-only self-smoke.` Contract docs still instruct operators to run against `tests/fixtures/backplane/valid_run.json` (`docs/contracts/run-contract-v1.md:223`).

## Scope
- `scripts/validate_run_contract.py`
- `tests/fixtures/backplane/` (new)
- `docs/contracts/run-contract-v1.md`

## Non-Goals
- Scaffold-only completion does NOT count: checking in an empty `tests/fixtures/backplane/` directory without the JSON cases enumerated in `scripts/validate_run_contract.py:584-598` is a failure of this issue.
- Do NOT implement `scripts/emit_reference_run.sh` or a live run emitter in this issue.

## Tasks
- [ ] Commit the backplane fixture tree expected by `scripts/validate_run_contract.py:569-598` under `tests/fixtures/backplane/` so `_self_smoke` runs envelope cases instead of printing `NOTE: no fixtures found`.
- [ ] Add a participant registry file beside `config/` as required by `scripts/validate_run_contract.py:552` when invoking `--self-smoke` from CI.
- [ ] Add a pytest module under `tests/` that shells out to `scripts/validate_run_contract.py --self-smoke` and fails on any unexpected `FAIL fixture` line.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `pytest tests/ -k validate_run_contract_self_smoke` passes when fixtures are present.
- Deliberate break: delete `tests/fixtures/backplane/valid_run.json`, run the named pytest, verify FAIL, revert.

_Surfaced by Track D repo-audit 2026-09-23; verified by running `--self-smoke` on tip `5fb9a7d`._
title: [P2] Backplane validator self-smoke fixtures documented but absent from repo
